description.plain:
Meet the Tosiicop LiPo Battery Charger, a compact balance charger designed for 2S, 3S, and 4S LiPo and LiHV packs. With an 18W, 2A output, it facilitates balanced charging across all cells, helping each pack reach a clean, even voltage. The lightweight 128 g chassis fits easily in a backpack or workshop setup, making routine battery maintenance simple between sessions.

Built for versatile RC gear, this charger supports a wide range of applications—from RC cars and monster trucks to boats, airplanes, FPV drones, quadcopters, and even airsoft gear that uses common XH connectors. It covers LiPo packs at 7.4–14.8V and LiHV packs at 8.7–17.4V, across 2S–4S configurations, with XH3P, XH4P, and XH5P plug compatibility for flexible setup.

Smart protections and clear status

  • Intelligent IC-based charging guards against overvoltage, overload, overheating, and overcharging, helping protect both the battery and charger over time.
  • Charging indicators provide clear feedback: a flashing light during charging, a steady light when idle, and a steady light when complete. Use the start/stop button to control charging sessions.

Specifications at a glance

  • Input: AC 100–240V; Output: 18W 2A; Battery types: LiPo/LiHV (2–4S)
  • Weight: ~128 g; Compact footprint makes it easy to store or travel with.

What’s included

  • 1 × LiPo/LiHV Balance Charger
  • 1 × User Manual
  • 1 × XH3P-XH5P Fast Charging Cable

Notes: Please verify battery interfaces match before ordering and always consult the manual before use. This charger aims to provide balanced charging for your LiPo and LiHV packs, supporting a variety of RC setups with reliable, practical performance.

FAQ

Q: Is this charger compatible with LiPo/LiHV packs and 2S-4S cells?

A: Yes, designed for LiPo/LiHV 2S-4S packs with XH3P-XH5P connectors; ensure battery interface matches.

Q: How can I tell charging is finished?

A: The indicator flashes while charging, stays solid when complete; press the start/stop button to control sessions.

Meet the Tosiicop LiPo Battery Charger, a compact balance charger designed for 2S, 3S, and 4S LiPo and LiHV packs. With an 18W, 2A output, it facilitates balanced charging across all cells, helping each pack reach a clean, even voltage. The lightweight 128 g chassis fits easily in a backpack or workshop setup, making routine battery maintenance simple between sessions.

Built for versatile RC gear, this charger supports a wide range of applications—from RC cars and monster trucks to boats, airplanes, FPV drones, quadcopters, and even airsoft gear that uses common XH connectors. It covers LiPo packs at 7.4–14.8V and LiHV packs at 8.7–17.4V, across 2S–4S configurations, with XH3P, XH4P, and XH5P plug compatibility for flexible setup.

Smart protections and clear status

  • Charging indicators provide clear feedback: a flashing light during charging, a steady light when idle, and a steady light when complete. Use the start/stop button to control charging sessions.

Specifications at a glance

  • Input: AC 100–240V; Output: 18W 2A; Battery types: LiPo/LiHV (2–4S)
  • Weight: ~128 g; Compact footprint makes it easy to store or travel with.

What’s included

  • 1 × LiPo/LiHV Balance Charger
  • 1 × User Manual
  • 1 × XH3P-XH5P Fast Charging Cable

Notes: Please verify battery interfaces match before ordering and always consult the manual before use. This charger aims to provide balanced charging for your LiPo and LiHV packs, supporting a variety of RC setups with reliable, practical performance.

FAQ

Q: Is this charger compatible with LiPo/LiHV packs and 2S-4S cells?

A: Yes, designed for LiPo/LiHV 2S-4S packs with XH3P-XH5P connectors; ensure battery interface matches.

Q: How can I tell charging is finished?

A: The indicator flashes while charging, stays solid when complete; press the start/stop button to control sessions.
